questions.stem: Which of the following is the most characteristic feature of Meniere's disease?

options.label: A
options.text: Progressive unilateral hearing loss with gradual onset

options.label: B
options.text: Episodic vertigo with fluctuating hearing loss and tinnitus

options.label: C
options.text: Sudden onset of unilateral hearing loss without vertigo

options.label: D
options.text: Persistent vertigo with stable hearing loss and no tinnitus
